name: Antonina
quote: Explore the other side of the codes.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning. Anything on the agenda today?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Hello. Should we do the daily system maintenance together? You're welcome to join me.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Eh? Are you going to work into the evening?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Look at the time... I guess you enjoy staying up late, Professor.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Hi! Anything I can help you with? I'm always online and ready to help! ...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: System maintenance is a time-consuming task, but at the end of the day, someone's gotta do it.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor... are you asleep?

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Miss Persicaria? Please don't bring me sweetened coffee anymore.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: What's the matter, Professor? Do we need a routine check-up on the Dolls' neural code?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Nyan? ... Ugh.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Please do not.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Please remain professional during work hours, Professor.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Leave the tasks to me!

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: It's me, Antonina! Your reliable network security assistant! Nice to meet you! ... Oh, it's you, Professor.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I seem to have become a little more proficient.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: No matter what hardships lie ahead of us, I will not falter. Please put your faith in me, Professor.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I no longer feel any hesitation... I have been growing, and I will face our fate together with you, Professor.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Please, let me join you.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Switched to battle mode.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: DDoS attack initiated!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: As expected.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Hmm... that was easier than I thought.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: No... I can't stop here...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Please allow me to express my gratitude, Professor. You led me to recognize my true purpose in existence. I-I never expected you'd make such a decision... I'm not really prepared for this, but... I'm happy for it.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. Stay true to your convictions, and I'll be behind you all the way.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: I never understood the point of giving people chocolate on Valentine's Day, but... here. Take it.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Is it really possible to view the star Vega from within Magrasea? ... What a beautiful sight.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: If you're not even going to bother giving us any candy on Halloween, I might just have to mess with your computer a little bit. Don't worry, I won't do anything too terrible.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: It's Christmas... Oh, by the way, do you think the Santa Claus in Magrasea also hands out gifts while the reindeers pull his sleigh?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Birthday...? So it's the day you were born into this world? Now that I think about it, it is indeed a special day. I haven't prepared anything for you, but if there is something you want, I'll do my best to get it for you as a present. No strange requests, though.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: So, you getting used to the virtual world yet? When in doubt, come ask me, Antonina! I'm the finest network engineer 42Lab has to offer!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: "When in doubt, come ask me, Antonina!"... I'm sick of talking like that. What? Why am I changing my tone? Well... You've already seen my true colors, so why keep pretending?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: It's getting on my nerves... Oh, Professor? Can you please not sneak up on me like that? I'm trying to think... I'm sorry, I've just been preoccupied with all these strange thoughts lately. But... you can stay here if you're fine with listening to my ramblings, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Antonina. They've all gotten so used to calling me "Anna" that they forgot my real name. Now, no one remembers except Persicaria and a few other Dolls. But you remember, don't you, Professor?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: It's high time I stopped second-guessing myself... I no longer feel lost, now that I've found someone who's willing to listen to all my ramblings and secrets. Thank you, Professor. I look forward to our future together.

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Mm.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: ...Sigh

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehe.

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Ehhh!?

career:
H-01, a network technology research Doll developed by 42Lab, is equipped with a large number of 42Lab's proprietary cutting-edge technologies. H-01's data processing and computing performance levels have both reached the industry's top standards.

Antonina belongs to the 42Lab Cyber Security Department, where she works on information security research. She is responsible for dealing with corporate cyber vulnerabilities, setting up virtual network defense systems, and tracking down hackers attempting to illegally invade network systems. As a senior cyber security engineer, Antonina has participated in multiple confidential advanced projects of 42Lab.

After the initiation of Project Neural Cloud's testing, 42Lab sent Antonina to join the test to ensure the project's success.
infoStories:
As the chief cyber security expert of 42Lab, Antonina has been required to attend many social events. For this reason, she downloaded various information on social etiquette and proper wording, and practiced until she was able to diplomatically handle all kinds of situations.

Therefore, Antonina has been taking on a persona in front of most people, as the lively and lovely "Anna". Only those who know her well can get to know the real her as "Antonina". It is also for this reason that whenever someone calls her "Anna" in private, Antonina always corrects them, in an attempt to clearly distinguish herself from her persona.

Since Antonina's actions are, in a way, interpreted as a representation of 42Lab's stance, she cannot express her attitudes and opinions in public. To compensate for that, Antonina has been active under multiple fake identities in private, some of which even became famous in the industry for being abnormally active with outstanding capabilities.

Antonina often receives challenges from all around the world, some of which are for fame and riches, while others for showing off.

Antonina had never taken a liking to them. Not because she disliked these actions, but because they posted a threat so insignificant, she did not have it in her to answer those challenges.

For this purpose, except for basic security systems, Antonina prepared a Deep Learning AI to deal with these annoyances. The Neural Network of this AI was in reality copied from Persicaria by Antonina.

Usually, the AI learns through observing Antonina's work, taking care of any leaks that can bypass security measures for her. As a result, many of the outside world would often claim that they had broken though 42Lab's network security systems, only to be discovered and swiftly taken down by Antonina. None would know that their opponent was merely an AI.

Antonina only made her identity public once, during a previous operation. It was an operation against a super-virus that swept through the world. Developed by an anti-doll organization, the program was extremely destructive to a Doll's neural system and could erase or even rewrite basic logic. In the first month of its spread, nearly 20,000 Dolls around the world were infected and destroyed. This incident angered many Doll security network experts, who spontaneously banded together to develop disinfecting programs and new anti-virus logic architectures.

Antonina was the first to deliver a perfect solution to this crisis only one week after the virus started to spread on a large scale. She not only developed a program that effectively stopped the destruction process, but also an anti-virus program for emergencies.

At the end of the following month, Antonina, together with the temporary response team set up by the International Criminal Police Organization, tracked down the virus' developer and successfully solved the crisis.

Antonina's daily routine is quite odd. It is rare even among Dolls. Just like human otaku programmers, Antonina never abides by the schedule set up for dolls, and she's even printed a card that said "Staying up late is harmful to the body, which is why I stay up all night" and hung it up on the door of her office.

Although a chaotic schedule is less harmful to Dolls than living humans, Dolls are still not entirely immune to its impact. Antonina once stayed up 84 hours, both working and playing without any rest. This led to a complete breakdown of her neural system at the subsequent work summary meeting.

For this reason, 42Lab had strengthened its penalties for these insane programmers, but nothing could stop them from digging their own grave.

"Maybe I can't do anything about the schedule, but to say I can't do anything about the supervisory programs? It's all just a few clicks away."
—An anonymous poster on 42Lab's Internal Forum. The poster is suspected to be a cyber-security department member.

The project has reached its final stage.

In the previous experiments, ███ has far exceeded our expectations. From the threat-elimination effectiveness to self-learning and self-correcting abilities, it has displayed above-average performance.

With adequate follow-up technical support, ███ is already capable of taking on the responsibility of ensuring Magrasea's ultra-cloud cyber security.

Meanwhile: ███ has displayed above-average performance as well, though it was comparatively inferior to ███.

There is no denying that ███ has potential, but the possible risks should not be ignored.

Whether it may realize evolution functions on its own, or fall into the hands of potential third parties through certain means, ███ could potentially bring us unwanted danger. It is also theoretically the only one capable of threatening the existence of ███.

Before taking our next steps, further discussion is advised.
oathDesc: Approach her, learn all about her hidden side, and become the one and only person who knows about that special part of her.

projections.name: Cyber Security Master
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"It's easy for me to disguise as someone else as a white hat, but hard to feel comfortable being myself."

projections.name: Cyber Security Master
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"It's easy for me to disguise as someone else as a white hat, but hard to feel comfortable being myself."

projections.name: Cyber Deep Diver
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Think long and hard about whether you're in for a honeypot when you launch an attack on a white hat."

skinList.name: Snowy Evening
skinList.desc:
[Christmas Eve Invitation Series]
Wearing a festive-themed outfit lends a sense of ceremony to tonight's encounter.
"For me? Hm... I'll just treat it as my payment for helping you set up the party then."
Her snow-white sleeves offset her pink cheeks very well. Looks like tonight will be a merry one.

skinList.name: First Command
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection—"Protect your information security? I've been doing that from the very first second I was awakened."

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"Do your best Anna No. 2, you still have 10 support tickets and 30 bugs to clear by tonight~"

skinList.name: Veiled Refrain
skinList.desc:
"Lightless Procession" Series — Antonina's role in the Halloween Manuscript. A witch manipulating devilish magic, wielding the winds and waves in the strange seas. Will you answer the call to embark upon this adventure?
"As reparation for normal times, let's enjoy Halloween together properly. Take public revenge for private wrongs? What could you possibly mean?"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"This is just a gift of obligation and courtesy, there definitely isn't any other meaning to it. In... In any case, just take it already and stop laughing like a dork!"

skinList.name: Sunshine Blossom
skinList.desc:
After accepting her sincere invitation, you spend an unforgettable summer day at the fairground together. Both your heart and hers will always race as you recall your time together.
"Relax, it's not like I was waiting long or anything. Oh yes, take your ice-cream, I went out of my way to get your favorite flavor and it'll melt if you don't take it."

skinList.name: Minty Jelly
skinList.desc:
Revel in a rare moment of relaxation on a sunny, lazy afternoon. As you open the door, the sugary scent of leisure hits you.
Lounging in her domicile filled with piles of equipment, Antonina raises her head. A not oft seen soft side of her lies before your eyes, her lethargic countenance bathing in the sunlight.

skinList.name: Hallowed Witch's Halls
skinList.desc:
Bizarre candlelight flickers amidst the curtains, the scent of honey and blood intermingles. The witch looks down upon her visitors, frost in her eyes. 
""A pact? I am the law here. Choose, then—purgatory or servitude?""
